records.issue_text: new embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb only tests class hierarchy and lacks test coverage for create/update/destroy behavior, including the not-found case
records.rationale: The diff adds Admin::EmbeddableHostsController with nontrivial create/update/destroy logic (including save_host with defaulting category_id and an update path where a missing id yields a nil host passed to save_host), yet the new spec only asserts 'Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController'. Missing tests for newly added nontrivial logic is a concrete, actionable review concern grounded in the diff.
